en.headline: SFC orders ChaPanda operator to suspend trading from Tuesday morning
en.dek: The regulator directed the Stock Exchange to halt dealings in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial under rules covering potentially false or misleading documents.

zh.headline: 證監會指令茶百道營運商周二早上起停牌
zh.dek: 監管機構指示聯交所根據涉及文件可能載有虛假或誤導資料的規則，暫停四川百茶百道實業股份買賣。

en.headline: Animals Asia therapy dog programme booked out until February 2027
en.dek: The Dr Dog and Professor Paws visits, run by one staff member and 65 volunteers, are finalists in the teamwork category of the Spirit of Hong Kong Awards.

zh.headline: 亞洲動物基金治療犬計劃預約至2027年2月已滿
zh.dek: 由一名職員及65名義工組成的Dr Dog及Professor Paws探訪計劃，獲提名競逐香港精神獎團隊合作組別。

en.headline: Marine Department coordinates with Guangdong ahead of Friday yacht first voyage
en.dek: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said preparations include captain training, real-time monitoring and an electronic service system for the southbound Guangdong yachts.

zh.headline: 粵艇南下周五行首航 海事處與廣東密切溝通做好準備
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，當局已進行船長培訓考核、建立實時監察系統及電子業務系統，並會加強安全提示及巡邏。

en.headline: Two men arrested after fight over money in Ma On Shan car park
en.dek: A 42-year-old and a 36-year-old were detained early Tuesday after a dispute in a car park on Kam Ying Road; both were taken to hospital with minor injuries.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山停車場兩男因錢財問題互毆 涉公眾地方打鬥被捕
zh.dek: 今早約3時40分，錦英路6號停車場兩名男子因金錢問題爭執互毆，分別頭部及頸部受傷送院，警方以涉嫌公眾地方打鬥拘捕。

en.headline: Man injured after charger overheats in Tsz Ching Estate flat fire
en.dek: About 250 residents were evacuated from Ching On House in Tsz Wan Shan after a fire early Tuesday; a 70-year-old man was taken to hospital.

zh.headline: 慈正邨正安樓單位充電器過熱起火 七旬男戶主受傷 約250人疏散
zh.dek: 慈雲山慈正邨正安樓24樓單位今早約6時起火，初步相信外置充電器過熱引起，七旬男戶主燒傷送院，約250名居民疏散。

en.headline: Space Museum 3D dome show on the solar system ends Wednesday
en.dek: The Great Solar System Adventure 3D at the Hong Kong Space Museum runs until 14 October, with screenings for families and adults.

zh.headline: 太空館太陽系3D穹幕影院節目周三結束
zh.dek: 香港太空館「太陽系大冒險3D」穹幕影院節目將於10月14日結束，適合家庭及成人觀賞。

en.headline: Food safety centre orders recall of Kung Wo rose fermented beancurd
en.dek: A sample from a Sham Shui Po retailer contained 140,000 Bacillus cereus per gram, exceeding the unsatisfactory threshold for ready-to-eat food.

zh.headline: 食安中心指公和玫瑰腐乳含過量蠟樣芽孢桿菌 指示停售回收
zh.dek: 深水埗零售商抽取樣本每克含14萬個蠟樣芽孢桿菌，超出即食食品不滿意水平，受影響批次僅48瓶。

en.headline: Man dies after collapsing while repairing pipe at Ma On Shan flat
en.dek: A man in his sixties was certified dead at Prince of Wales Hospital after his daughter found him unconscious in the bathroom of their Kam Ying Court home.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山錦英苑男子修水管時暈倒 送院不治
zh.dek: 六旬男子於錦英苑錦達閣家中廁所維修水管時突然暈倒，女兒報案，送威爾斯親王醫院搶救至晚上10時03分證實不治。

en.headline: Police charge woman over fake Andy Hui concert tickets sold online
en.dek: A 48-year-old woman faces four counts after buyers paid about HK$20,000 for 14 invalid tickets to the Hung Hom shows.

zh.headline: 警方起訴48歲女子涉網售許志安演唱會假門票
zh.dek: 女子被控四項以欺騙手段取得財產，六名買家以約2萬元購買14張無效門票。

en.headline: Garden Company apologises after crowd chaos at student sandwich event
en.dek: The bakery said no one was injured when parents pushing to collect children broke a door handle at the Wan Chai school hall.

zh.headline: 嘉頓就學生三文治活動散場混亂致歉 承諾檢討人流安排
zh.dek: 公司指無人受傷，部分家長推撞令禮堂大門門柄脫落，將審視日後大型活動入場及人流管制。

en.headline: ICAC charges six including former Cyberport section head over subsidy fraud
en.dek: The Independent Commission Against Corruption alleges bribery and conspiracy involving about HK$20 million in government technology grants.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴數碼港前總監等六人涉貪及詐騙資助
zh.dek: 廉政公署指涉案人士涉嫌行賄受賄及串謀詐騙，涉款約2000萬元數碼轉型支援先導計劃資助。

en.headline: Police arrest domestic helper over death of 93-year-old woman in Kai Tak
en.dek: Officers say closed-circuit footage shows the helper striking the elderly woman multiple times before seeking help on Sunday.

zh.headline: 啟德德朗邨九旬婦身亡 外傭涉謀殺被捕
zh.dek: 警方指閉路電視顯示外傭周日早上多次擊打老婦頭頸面部，其後求助，老婦送院不治。

en.headline: Police arrest employer after suspected illegal worker found dead in Mai Po fish pond
en.dek: A 37-year-old mainland man was discovered in a fish pond in the early hours of Monday; a 70-year-old operator was held over alleged illegal employment.

zh.headline: 米埔魚塘發現屍體 僱主涉聘用非法勞工被捕
zh.dek: 37歲內地男子周一凌晨被發現倒臥魚塘，70歲魚塘經營者被警方以涉嫌聘用不可合法受僱人士拘捕。

en.headline: Electronics fairs open Tuesday with more than 120 robots on show
en.dek: The Hong Kong Electronics Fair and electronicAsia will bring over 3,200 exhibitors to Wan Chai, highlighting AI applications and interactive robot demonstrations.

zh.headline: 秋電展及電子組件展周二開幕 展出逾120款機械人
zh.dek: 香港秋季電子產品展及國際電子組件展將於灣仔會展舉行，匯聚逾3200家展商，重點展示人工智能應用及互動機械人示範。

en.headline: West Kowloon eyes 2027/28 as turning point towards operating returns
en.dek: Board chairman Bernard Chan told lawmakers the cultural district recorded its highest operating revenue yet and expects major facilities to shift the focus from cash flow to self-sustaining income.

zh.headline: 西九文化區2027/28年度邁向營運收成期
zh.dek: 管理局董事局主席陳智思向立法會議員表示，西九上年度營運收入創新高，預期隨主要設施落成，重點將由現金流轉為自我持續收入。

en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 59 points at 24271
en.dek: The index finished 0.25 per cent higher after an early rally faded, with mainland banks among the stronger performers and turnover at about 162.6 billion dollars.

zh.headline: 恒指高收59點報24271 內銀股造好
zh.dek: 恒指全日升0.25%，早段曾高見24455點後回吐，主板成交約1626億元。

en.headline: Development chief stresses ecology and heritage in Northern Metropolis
en.dek: Bernadette Linn said the government would balance growth with the area's history and natural resources, naming a San Tin trail as next year's first rural-urban integration project.

zh.headline: 甧漢豪：北都發展珍視生態歷史文化 推動城鄉共融
zh.dek: 發展局局長稱政府明年推出「新田時光步道」作為首個重點城鄉共融項目，並已成立兩億元基金支持社區主導計劃。

en.headline: SFC approves six share registrars for paperless securities market
en.dek: The approvals take effect when the uncertificated securities market launches on 16 November, with two firms cleared to offer conversion and transfer services from day one.

zh.headline: 證監會核准六家證券登記機構 無紙市場下月實施
zh.dek: 核准自11月16日無紙證券市場制度實施起生效，其中兩家已獲准提供紙本轉無紙及相關轉讓服務。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection assesses Russian pneumonia case as low risk
en.dek: The centre said there is no evidence of sustained transmission and it has stepped up health monitoring of arrivals from Russia at the airport.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心：俄羅斯不明肺炎個案對港即時風險低
zh.dek: 中心指未有持續傳播證據，已加強在機場對俄羅斯抵港旅客的健康監測。

en.headline: HKU study finds chronic disease scheme improves health indicators
en.dek: Nearly 6,000 participants with newly diagnosed diabetes, hypertension or prediabetes showed significant gains after one year of follow-up under the government pilot.

zh.headline: 港大研究：慢病共治計劃一年後健康指標顯著改善
zh.dek: 近6000名新確診糖尿病、高血壓或前期糖尿病參加者完成一年跟進後，血糖血壓等指標明顯改善。

en.headline: Labour Department sanctions two firms over imported labour applications
en.dek: Shengshi Investment Management and Ho Fu Kee Noodle House in Tsuen Wan had their applications halted and face a two-year ban after refusing qualified local job seekers for dishwasher posts.

zh.headline: 勞工處制裁兩公司 中止輸入洗碗員申請兩年
zh.dek: 盛世投資管理及荃灣何富記麵家因無合理理由拒絕聘用合資格本地求職者等違規，即時中止申請並禁未來兩年再申請。

en.headline: Government appoints Li Zili as drug and medical device regulator
en.dek: The Director of Health said the appointment of the experienced specialist will help build Hong Kong's capacity for independent review and approval of drugs and devices.

zh.headline: 政府委任李自力為藥械監管總監 任期三年
zh.dek: 衛生署署長指，委任具豐富國際經驗的專才，有助建立本港自主藥械審評審批能力，加快符合品質及安全要求的產品臨床應用。

en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum continues at Kai Tak AIRSIDE until late November
en.dek: The Swedish exhibition of more than 80 polarising foods from around the world is open at GATE33 Gallery in AIRSIDE, with interactive displays and a tasting bar.

zh.headline: 嘔心食物博物館啟德AIRSIDE展至十一月底
zh.dek: 來自瑞典的展覽在啟德AIRSIDE GATE33藝文館展出逾80款各地爭議性食物，設互動展區及試食吧，展期至11月26日。

en.headline: Police treat death of elderly woman in Kai Tak as murder, arrest Indonesian helper
en.dek: A woman in her nineties was found unresponsive at De Lang Estate on Sunday morning and later died in hospital; police arrested the Indonesian domestic helper and are investigating as murder.

zh.headline: 啟德德朗邨九旬婦不治 警列謀殺案拘捕印傭
zh.dek: 一名九旬婦人周日早上在牛頭角德朗邨德瑤樓被發現失去知覺，送院後不治；警方拘捕印尼籍女傭，案件列作謀殺跟進。

en.headline: Four vehicles including three KMB buses collide on Tsing Kwai Highway
en.dek: The collision near Container Terminal 5 at about 11.42am on Monday closed some lanes; one bus driver reported back pain while the Transport Department advised drivers to use remaining lanes.

zh.headline: 青葵公路四車相撞包括三輛九巴 一名車長背痛
zh.dek: 周一上午約11時42分葵涌青葵公路往機場方向近五號貨櫃碼頭發生四車相撞，涉及三輛九巴，部分行車線封閉。

en.headline: Mainland man found dead in Mai Po fish pond, employer arrested
en.dek: Police recovered the body of a 37-year-old man early Monday and arrested a 70-year-old pond owner on suspicion of employing an illegal worker.

zh.headline: 米埔魚塘發現內地男子屍體 僱主涉聘黑工被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一凌晨將37歲男子遺體撈起，並拘捕70歲塘主，涉嫌僱用非法勞工。

en.headline: Hand-painted lanterns continue at Wan Chai Blue House until Wednesday
en.dek: More than 700 lanterns painted by residents and local illustrators light up the historic Blue House cluster and nearby streets each evening until 14 October.

zh.headline: 灣仔藍屋手繪花燈展延至周三 每晚亮燈
zh.dek: 超過700盞由街坊及本地插畫家手繪的花燈，每晚6時至9時半點亮藍屋建築群及附近街道，展期至10月14日。

en.headline: Minibus and truck collide on San Tin Highway, multiple injured
en.dek: A green minibus and a goods vehicle collided near Fairview Park at about 9.24am, with most of the injured reported as lightly hurt and some lanes closed.

zh.headline: 新田公路近錦繡花園小巴與貨車相撞 多人受傷
zh.dek: 周一上午約9時24分，元朗新田公路近錦繡花園一輛專線小巴與貨車相撞，大部分傷者輕傷，部分行車線封閉。

en.headline: Redeveloped Huanggang Port opens at 6.30am with joint clearance
en.dek: The new port began 24-hour operations this morning, with the first passengers using collaborative inspection that aims to cut clearance to about five minutes.

zh.headline: 新皇崗口岸今早6時半開通 首批旅客以合作查驗過關
zh.dek: 重建後皇崗口岸周一清晨6時半正式開通，提供24小時通關，首批旅客使用合作查驗一次放行模式。

en.headline: Three women arrested after brawl at Mong Kok nail salon
en.dek: Police held three women on suspicion of fighting in a public place after a confrontation at Argyle Centre; one jewellery shop worker was injured.

zh.headline: 旺角中心美甲店打鬥 警拘3名女子
zh.dek: 周日傍晚旺角中心一間美甲店發生打鬥，警方以涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥拘捕3名女子，其中一人受傷送院。

en.headline: Tram derails on Shau Kei Wan East Street and mounts pavement
en.dek: A tram left the tracks early Monday near ground-floor shops, with nearly half the carriage scraping onto the walkway; police are investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 筲箕灣東大街電車出軌 近半車箱鏟上行人路
zh.dek: 周一凌晨筲箕灣東大街一輛電車離開路軌，近半車箱鏟上行人路並接近地舖，警方正調查成因。

en.headline: Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival tickets go on public sale today
en.dek: The Tourism Board's four-day waterfront event runs from 29 October to 1 November at the Central Harbourfront, with public booking of tasting passes starting this morning.

zh.headline: 香港美酒佳餚巡禮門票今日公開發售
zh.dek: 旅發局主辦的四天海濱美食盛事將於10月29日至11月1日在中環海濱舉行，品味證今日起公開發售。

en.headline: Yellow Bus ends nearly 30-year service as new Huanggang Port opens
en.dek: The last northbound Yellow Bus to the old port leaves San Tin between 6.15am and 6.20am today, after which the cross-boundary shuttle is retired under the new joint-clearance arrangements.

zh.headline: 皇巴近30年服務今早結束 新皇崗口岸啟用
zh.dek: 往舊口岸北行尾班皇巴於今早6時15分至6時20分由新田開出，此後接駁服務將告終，改由新口岸一地兩檢安排取代。

en.headline: Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo continues with Monday showcases
en.dek: The second edition of HKPAX runs through 13 October with international and local performances, including dance and drama pieces today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre, Tai Kwun and Fringe Club.

zh.headline: 香港演藝博覽周一繼續 多場國際及本地演出
zh.dek: 第二屆香港演藝博覽延續至10月13日，周一有舞蹈及戲劇節目於東九文化中心、大館及藝穗會上演。

en.headline: Customs seize 15kg suspected ketamine at airport, arrest Malaysian woman
en.dek: Officers found the drugs concealed in coffee powder packages in the checked luggage of a 28-year-old passenger who arrived from Paris via Taipei; the case remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢15公斤懷疑氯胺酮 拘28歲馬來西亞女
zh.dek: 關員在由巴黎經台北抵港的女子寄倉行李咖啡粉包裝內發現毒品，估計市值約540萬元，案件仍在調查。

en.headline: Cycling federation apologises after pilot car error skips Ting Kau Bridge
en.dek: The Cycling Association of Hong Kong, China said a lead vehicle misjudged the route after cones were moved for an earlier accident, sending 32km riders the wrong way and causing bottlenecks.

zh.headline: 單車總會就領航車誤判致歉 32公里組錯失汀九橋
zh.dek: 中國香港單車總會表示，因早前意外需移動雪糕筒開通緊急通道，32公里組領航車誤判路線，未轉入汀九橋並造成短暫堵塞。

en.headline: Man airlifted after feeling unwell and falling on Tung Chung hike
en.dek: A 40-year-old man in a group of six was hoisted by Government Flying Service helicopter from near Pak To Shan after feeling unwell and slipping, then taken to Ruttonjee Hospital.

zh.headline: 東涌外籍男子行山不適跌傷 直升機吊起送院
zh.dek: 下午約2時，東涌壁刀屹附近一名約40歲男子懷疑中暑不適並跌倒受傷，政府飛行服務隊直升機將事主吊起送律敦治醫院治療。

en.headline: Saltwater pipe bursts on Yau Tong Ko Chiu Road, spraying water three metres high
en.dek: A saltwater pipe ruptured near the community hall around 6pm, sending a fountain of water and debris onto the pavement and disrupting traffic until staff closed the valve.

zh.headline: 油塘高超道煙水管爆裂 水柱高達三米
zh.dek: 晚上約6時油塘高超道社區會堂對出煙水管爆裂，水花四溅高達三米，路面滿佈沙石，水務署人員到場關斷水擁槍修。

en.headline: Chief Executive officiates at Huanggang Port opening ceremony
en.dek: John Lee said the redeveloped port is a landmark for Greater Bay Area connectivity as it prepares to open at 6.30am tomorrow with about five-minute clearance.

zh.headline: 行政長官出席皇崗口岸開通儀式
zh.dek: 李家超稱重建後的口岸是大灣區連通的里程碑，將於明早6時半開通，通關時間約縮至5分鐘。

en.headline: Man dies after collapsing on Wu Kau Tang hike
en.dek: A Government Flying Service helicopter airlifted the hiker from Ha Miu Tin in Tai Po to Eastern Hospital, where he was pronounced dead despite resuscitation efforts.

zh.headline: 男子大埔烏蛊騰行山暈倒 送院搶救不治
zh.dek: 政府飛行服務隊直升機將事主由烏蛊騰下苗田送往東區醫院，經急救後證實不治。

en.headline: High-speed trains to Zhanjiang add stop at Taishan from today
en.dek: MTR said daily services between West Kowloon and Zhanjiang West now call at Taishan, bringing the number of direct stations to 114.

zh.headline: 高鐵西九龍至湛江西車次今起加停台山站
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，每日來往西九龍及湛江西的列車加停台山，直達站點增至114個，方便市民回鄉探親。

en.headline: Police arrest man over 23,000 fraudulent customer-service calls
en.dek: A 24-year-old man was held after officers found a SIM-box modem that placed more than 23,000 scam calls in a week, with one victim losing over HK$100,000.

zh.headline: 警拘24歲男涉逾2.3萬通假冒客服電話騙案
zh.dek: 警方在將軍澳住宅單位發現仍在運作的SIM卡數據機，一週內撥出逾2.3萬通詐騙電話，至少一名受害人損失逾10萬元。

en.headline: Three arrested over flour-laced threat letters in renovation fee dispute
en.dek: Police held two principals and a staff member of a Kwun Tong renovation firm after a catering group received more than 30 letters containing white powder confirmed as flour.

zh.headline: 裝修公司3人涉寄麵粉恐嚇信被捕 追討百萬工程費
zh.dek: 警方拕捕觀塘裝修公司兩名負責人及一名職員，涉嫌因金錢糾紛向餐飲集團寄出逾30封載有麵粉的恐嚇信。

en.headline: Hill fire burns 30-metre line near Yuen Long Kam Sheung Road
en.dek: Firefighters and a Government Flying Service helicopter tackled a blaze near Cheung Ngau Shan and Jing Hang Shan from about 11am; no injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 元朗錦上路附近山火火線約30米 直升機投水彈
zh.dek: 周日早上約11時，掌牛山及井坑山附近發生山火，消防及政府飛行服務隊直升機到場撲救，暫未有傷亡報告。

en.headline: More than 6,000 cyclists take part in Hong Kong Cyclothon
en.dek: The annual event featured a new 56-kilometre route through the Central Kowloon Bypass for the first time, with start and finish at the West Kowloon Cultural District.

zh.headline: 香港單車節逾6千人參與 首度經中九龍繞道
zh.dek: 賽事起終點移至西九文化區，56公里組新增中九龍繞道路段，涵蓋五隧三橋。

en.headline: Observatory expects generally fine and dry weather for the work week
en.dek: An anticyclone aloft will bring sunny conditions from Monday to Friday, with daytime temperatures around 30 to 32 degrees and only isolated light rain patches later in the week.

zh.headline: 天文台料本周工作日大致天晴乾燥
zh.dek: 高空反氣旋影響下，周一至周五普遍天晴，日間氣溫約30至32度，周中後期或有一兩陣微雨。

en.headline: Customs seizes 5kg suspected cannabis at airport, arrests two
en.dek: Two mainland men arriving from Manila were arrested after officers found the drugs in a checked suitcase; they face trafficking charges in court tomorrow.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢約5公斤懷疑大麻花 兩名內地男被捕
zh.dek: 兩名由馬尼拉抵港的內地男子被控販運危險藥物，案件明於西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Chan outlines four priorities for Apec finance ministers meeting
en.dek: The Financial Secretary said the Hong Kong gathering will focus on livelihood-supporting fiscal policies, digital infrastructure, inclusive finance and young talent.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：APEC財長會聚焦民生財政、數字基建等四優先領域
zh.dek: 財政司司長指這四項屬香港優勢，首次在港舉行反映國家支持及本港國際金融中心地位。

en.headline: Financial Secretary leads delegation to Nanjing starting Monday
en.dek: Paul Chan will attend a Jiangsu-Hong Kong promotion conference and visit technology firms and Nanjing University during the two-day trip.

zh.headline: 財政司司長周一率團赴南京 推廣港作內地企業出海平台
zh.dek: 陳茂波將出席蘇港推介大會，並到訪創科企業及南京大學，期間副司長黃偉綸署任。

en.headline: Bar Association proposes proxy cap and electronic voting for owners meetings
en.dek: Chairman Jose-Antonio Maurellet said limiting the number of proxies a person can hold, without restricting who may hold them, would improve transparency and curb abuse in building procurement.

zh.headline: 大律師公會建議業主大會授權票設上限 反對限親屬
zh.dek: 主席毛樂禮指設數量上限最可行快捷，限制只可授權予親屬或同屋苑業主難以執行，建議加強透明度及引入電子投票。

en.headline: LCSD awards HK$122.8 million lifeguard contract despite past shortfalls
en.dek: The department gave a three-year outsourcing deal for six pools to Spotlight Enterprises, drawing union concerns over costs after earlier staffing failures.

zh.headline: 康文署批出1.228億元外判救生合約 工會質疑浪費
zh.dek: 署方將六個泳池三年救生及急救服務外判予博藝體運，合約值逾1.2億元，工會指夏季才缺人手，冬季資源浪費。

en.headline: Discovery Bay Weekend Market continues today at DB Plaza until 6pm
en.dek: Handmade Hong Kong’s two-day gathering of local makers runs from 11am Saturday to 6pm Sunday at Discovery Bay Plaza.

zh.headline: 愉景灣週末市集今續辦至下午6時 愉景廣場舉行
zh.dek: 香港手工製作主辦的兩日市集由周六上午11時至周日下午6時於愉景廣場舉行，免費入場。

en.headline: HKPAX stages two public ticketed shows today at East Kowloon Cultural Centre
en.dek: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo presents Paradisum and An Isolated Case this afternoon at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre, with tickets still available on URBTIX.

zh.headline: 香港演藝博覽今於東九文化中心呈獻兩場公眾售票演出
zh.dek: 香港演藝博覽今天下午於東九文化中心上演《天境重生》及《純屬個別事件》，門票現於城市售票網發售。

en.headline: Two cars collide on North Lantau Highway near Siu Ho Wan; four injured
en.dek: Two private cars crashed while heading towards the airport at about 7:03am on Sunday, with one vehicle overturning; police are investigating.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山公路近小蠔灣兩車相撞 一人翻側四傷
zh.dek: 周日早上約7時03分，兩輛私家車沿北大嶼山公路往機場方向行駛至近小蠔灣時相撞，其中一輛翻側，警方正調查。

en.headline: Planter fire at Tseung Kwan O PopCorn mall extinguished, no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a planter on the platform of the PopCorn mall in Tseung Kwan O late Saturday night; no one was hurt and no evacuation was needed.

zh.headline: 將軍澳PopCorn商場平台花槽起火 消防撲熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚上約11時31分，將軍澳唐賢街PopCorn商場平台花槽起火，消防將火救熄，無人受傷，毋須疏散。

en.headline: AFCD Leisure Nature Chill Fun Expo continues today in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: The free two-day event at East Point City runs from noon to 7pm, featuring exhibitions, workshops and sales of local agricultural and fisheries products.

zh.headline: 漁護署「漁農自然Chill好玩」博覽今續於將軍澳
zh.dek: 免費兩日活動於東港城1樓中庭中午至晚上7時舉行，設展覽、工作坊及本地農漁業產品銷售。

en.headline: Man in 20s attacked with knives at Tsuen Wan bar, suspects flee
en.dek: Police are investigating after a man in his twenties was stabbed in the head and hand at a bar on Sha Tsui Road in the early hours of Sunday.

zh.headline: 荃灣酒吧男子遭持刀襲擊 頭手受傷清醒送院
zh.dek: 警方調查周日凌晨約2時22分，一名20多歲男子在沙咀道酒吧遭兩至三名男子持刀襲擊，頭部及手部受傷。

en.headline: Observatory raises yellow fire danger warning at 6am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the yellow fire danger warning at 6:00 a.m., indicating a high fire risk, and reminded the public to take extra precautions.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨6時發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台於上午6時發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，提醒市民特別提高警覺並採取適當防火措施。

en.headline: Sundays By the Bay launches today at Pui O for Treasure Island's 30th
en.dek: The free monthly gathering at Treasure Island Campsite runs from noon to 6pm with live music, local makers and activities open to families and dogs.

zh.headline: 貝澳Treasure Island海灣週日今首辦 慶祝30週年
zh.dek: 免費活動由中午12時至下午6時於貝澳營地舉行，設現場音樂、本地手作及社區活動，歡迎一家大小及寵物狗參與。

en.headline: Anita Mui fan club says ashes urn missing from Po Lin Monastery since July
en.dek: On the late singer’s 63rd birthday the International Fan Club issued a statement that a fan found the niche empty on 18 July; police have been investigating for nearly three months.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳歌迷會指骨灰甕7月起在寶蓮禪寺失蹤
zh.dek: 周六為已故天后63歲冥壽，國際歌迷會發聲明稱7月18日歌迷發現海會塔靈位螺絲鬆脫、骨灰甕不翼而飛，報警近三個月仍未尋回。

en.headline: Cyclothon Carnival runs today at West Kowloon Art Park
en.dek: The free event at the Great Lawn accompanies the Hong Kong Cyclothon rides and races, with sports activities, food stalls and live performances from 6.30am to 6pm.

zh.headline: 單車節嘉年華今於西九藝術公園草地舉行
zh.dek: 活動由早上6時30分至下午6時免費入場，設運動市集、美食檔及互動體驗，配合香港單車節賽事。

en.headline: Mercedes catches fire on Tsing Sha Highway; driver and passenger escape unhurt
en.dek: A 1995 Mercedes S320 erupted in flames near Container Terminal 8 on Saturday night; firefighters raised the incident to a No. 2 alarm before extinguishing the blaze.

zh.headline: 青沙公路平治起火 司機乘客棄車逃生無人傷
zh.dek: 周六晚上約10時40分，一輊1995年平治S320在昂船洲大橋近八號貨櫃碼頭車頭冒煙起火，消防列作二級火警後將火救熄。

en.headline: Youth arrests rise 23 per cent in first eight months, police chief says
en.dek: Commissioner Joe Chow disclosed the figure while officiating a civic education ceremony, linking most cases to impulsive assaults, fraud involving bank accounts, and damage tied to debt collection.

zh.headline: 首八月逾2100名青少年被捕按年升23% 周一鳴：加強防罪宣傳
zh.dek: 警務處處長周一鳴在學界公民教育專員畢業禮上披露數據，指主要涉及傷人毆打、詐騙洗黑錢及與非法收債有關的刑事毀壞。

en.headline: Mark Six jackpot goes unclaimed in Saturday draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club draw returned numbers 12, 14, 20, 33, 34 and 37 with special number 31, leaving the first prize unwon and the next fund estimated at HK$28 million.

zh.headline: 周六六合彩頭獎無人中 下期基金估2800萬
zh.dek: 香港賽馬會周六攪珠，中獎號碼為12、14、20、33、34、37，特別號碼31，頭獎無人中，下期估計頭獎基金達2800萬港元。

en.headline: Civil service chief will not rule out discipline if Tai Po fire report names officials
en.dek: Secretary Ingrid Yeung said a support unit is being prepared for the Public Service Commission, and direct disciplinary action remains possible if the independent panel identifies individual failings.

zh.headline: 公務員事務局長：宏福苑報告若點名不排除直接紀律處分
zh.dek: 楊何蓓茵表示已準備支援小組協助公務員敍用委員會，若獨立委員會報告清晰指出個別公務員失職，不排除直接啟動紀律程序。

en.headline: Police arrest 127 in operation against Vietnamese-led loan-sharking syndicate
en.dek: Officers seized more than HK$2 million after a six-month undercover probe into a group that charged daily interest of HK$100 per HK$10,000 and ran illegal gambling and bars in West Kowloon.

zh.headline: 警破深水埗越南裔高利貸集團 拘127人年利率達3700厘
zh.dek: 有組織罪案科經半年臥底調查後，於8日至9日行動拘捕127人，檢獲逾200萬元得益，集團以同鄉會掩飾向同鄉放貴利並經營非法賭檔及酒吧。

en.headline: Election Committee nominations reach 756 candidate forms
en.dek: Returning officers received 71 more candidate nomination forms and one from a designated body on Saturday, the fourth day of the two-week nomination window.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉再接72份提名 累計756份候選人表格
zh.dek: 選舉主任周六接獲71份候選人提名表格及1份指定團體提名表格，提名期第四日，累計候選人提名表格達756份。

en.headline: Departments detail switchover plans for new Huanggang Port
en.dek: Immigration, Customs, Transport and Police set out clearance, transport and crowd arrangements for the 6.30am opening on Monday, when Lok Ma Chau services end.

zh.headline: 多部門公布新皇崗口岸周一轉換安排
zh.dek: 入境處、海關、運輸署及警務處詳列周一早上6時30分開通的清關、交通及人流安排，落馬洲服務屆時暫停。

en.headline: Firefighters and SPCA rescue three kittens from Yau Ma Tei courtyard
en.dek: The young cats, estimated at two to three months old, were freed from a vacant shop's light well on Shanghai Street after a cat volunteer reported faint meowing around midday.

zh.headline: 油麻地上海街天井三幼貓獲救 消防愛協合力破門
zh.dek: 中午時分貓義工報稱空置地舖傳出微弱貓聲，消防破門後與愛協救出約兩至三個月大幼貓，交義工照料。

en.headline: Immigration Department arrests 20 in week-long anti-illegal worker operations
en.dek: Officers detained 17 suspected illegal workers, two employers and one overstayer after raids on restaurants, renovation sites and beauty salons from 2 to 8 October.

zh.headline: 入境處一連七日反黑工行動拘捕20人
zh.dek: 入境事務處聯同警方等多個部門於10月2日至8日行動，在餐廳、裝修單位及美容院等處所拘捕17名懷疑非法勞工、兩名僱主及一名逾期逗留者。

en.headline: Police arrest 16 in operation against Tsim Sha Tsui prostitution syndicate
en.dek: West Kowloon officers seized more than HK$13 million in cash and froze over HK$5 million after targeting a group that arranged Thai women for hotel sex work and took a large share of the earnings.

zh.headline: 警破尖沙咀跨國賣淫集團 拘16人檢逾1300萬
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組於8日至9日行動，搞破招攭泰國女子在酒店賣淫並抽取大部分收益的集團，檢獲逾1300萬港元現金並凍結逾500萬港元。

en.headline: Mak outlines three-tier mechanism for building renovation disputes
en.dek: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said the planned system would involve district councillors first, then professional mediation, and finally the courts, with a target launch next year.

zh.headline: 麥美娟：明年推三層機制處理大廈管理糾紛
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟表示，計劃明年推行三層調解機制，先由區議員介入，再轉介專業調解，最終才交法庭處理，以改善包括大維修在內的大廈管理。

en.headline: Guangdong yachts to make first southbound voyage on 16 October
en.dek: The Transport and Logistics Bureau and Marine Department will hold a first-voyage ceremony next Friday to welcome the initial batch of Guangdong-registered yachts under the new reciprocal arrangement.

zh.headline: 「粵艇南下」首航儀式定於10月16日舉行
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，運輸及物流局與海事處將於下周五舉行「粵艇南下」首航儀式，迎接首批廣東遊艇來港。

en.headline: Department of Health runs Mental Recharge Station through Sunday
en.dek: The free event at MOSTown in Ma On Shan continues until Sunday evening to mark World Mental Health Day, with interactive games, workshops and a focus on listening to lived experience.

zh.headline: 衞生署「心靈補給站」馬鞍山展至周日
zh.dek: 為響應世界精神衞生日，衞生署在馬鞍山新港城中心舉辦免費活動，由周五起至周日傍晚，設互動遊戲及工作坊，強調聆聽親身經歷。

en.headline: Environment chief outlines 24-hour smart recycling and clean energy goals
en.dek: Secretary Tse Chin-wan said the government will expand community recycling with round-the-clock automated points and aims to raise the share of zero-carbon energy to 60 to 70 per cent by 2035.

zh.headline: 環境局長：推24小時智能回收 目標2035年零碳電力達六至七成
zh.dek: 環境及生態局局長謝展寰表示，政府將加強社區回收網絡，包括推出24小時智能回收桶，並有信心達至2035年零碳能源佔比六至七成的目標。

en.headline: Red flags hoisted at five beaches due to big waves
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department says swimmers should stay out of the water at Stanley Main, Shek O, Big Wave Bay, Silverstrand and Clear Water Bay Second Beach.

zh.headline: 五個泳灘因大浪懸掛紅旗
zh.dek: 康文署表示，赤柱正灘、石澳、大浪灣、銀線灣及清水灣第二灣因大浪懸掛紅旗，市民請勿游泳。

en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new Mpox case
en.dek: A 29-year-old man tested positive after developing symptoms, bringing this year's total to 30 cases as authorities step up vaccination and contact tracing.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新增猴痘確診個案
zh.dek: 一名29歲男子出現病徵後確診，今年累計30宗個案，中心加強疫苗接種及接觸者追蹤。

en.headline: Observatory expects fine and dry weather for the weekend
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory says Saturday and Sunday will be mainly fine and dry, with daytime highs around 31 degrees under moderate east to northeasterly winds.

zh.headline: 天文台預測周末大致天晴乾燥
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，周六及周日大致天晴及日間乾燥，市區最高氣溫約31度，吹和緩東至東北風。

en.headline: Police set phased Chung Yeung traffic controls from today
en.dek: Special arrangements run in multiple districts until early November to manage grave-sweeping traffic near cemeteries and columbaria.

zh.headline: 警方分階段實施重陽節特別交通安排
zh.dek: 多區由周四起至11月上旬實施封路、禁區及停車限制，以便利掃墓及維持交通暢順。

en.headline: Ciao Gelato Fest continues at PMQ through Sunday
en.dek: PMQ lists the Italian-style gelato market running from noon to 10pm on Saturday and Sunday at the ground-floor courtyard, with free entry.

zh.headline: 元創方Ciao意式雪糕市集展至周日
zh.dek: 元創方活動頁列出，意式雪糕市集周六及周日中午12時至晚上10時於地面廣場舉行，入場免費。
